periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible eye patches is oriented diagonally, tilted approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The eye patches exhibit an elongated oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering is present, with the lower margin extending significantly below the horizontal midline of the ocular region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a distance roughly equivalent to the width of a single ear at its base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears are predominantly semicircular and rounded.

other_distinctive_markers: The ventral and thoracic fur exhibits a significant brownish-tan discoloration compared to the whiter cranial fur.
